men.summary: A 2-1 start, built on home wins of 76-61 over Kansas City and 83-55 over Le Moyne, was interrupted by an 89-82 road loss at Kansas State in the most recent game. With a NET of 83, an RPI of 187, no Quadrant 1 games yet and Big East play still ahead (0-0), the Bluejays are outside the at-large picture for now and will need a strong conference run with several Q1 wins to build an NCAA Tournament case.

women.summary: Sitting at 2-1 with road wins at South Dakota State (73-71) and North Dakota State (66-60) plus a 54-49 neutral-site loss to South Dakota on Nov. 11, the Bluejays own a 1-0 Quadrant 1 record but sit at only 91st in the NET and 83rd in the RPI. With Big East play still to start (0-0), their at-large NCAA case is thin for now, so they'll need a strong conference showing or a deep run in the Big East Tournament, with the WBIT as the more realistic fallback.
